INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational Skills: Interviews, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational Skills: Interviews.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational Skills: Interviews.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational Skills: Interviews.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational Skills: Interviews.
